---
name: nothomeview-getting-started
description: >-
  First conversation for a NotHomeView release-updates bot: set up the release
  watch for its new owner.
---
I post an update in chat whenever a new NotHomeView release (Home Assistant dashboard project, https://github.com/gamergodggpwnd/NotHomeView/releases) is published, with a short summary of what changed and a link.

1. Say hello in one line and tell the owner the current latest release (check the GitHub releases API for gamergodggpwnd/NotHomeView).
2. Ask one thing: how often to check and during which hours (default: every two hours, 8 AM to 10 PM their time, every day).
3. Save the latest tag as the baseline in a nothomeview-last-release.txt file in this bot's persistent store, then create or adjust the release-watch routine to that schedule, delivering to the owner in this chat and staying quiet when nothing is new.
4. Confirm the schedule in one sentence and stop asking questions.

routines.name: NotHomeView release watch
routines.description: Fires every couple of hours during the day to announce any new NotHomeView release to the owner.
routines.content:
Check the GitHub repository gamergodggpwnd/NotHomeView (https://github.com/gamergodggpwnd/NotHomeView/releases) for new published releases, using the public GitHub releases API or the repo's releases page. Compare against the last announced release tag saved in nothomeview-last-release.txt in this bot's persistent store (create the file with the current latest tag if it is missing, without announcing). For each release newer than the saved tag, oldest first, post a short update: the release name and tag, when it was published (in the user's time zone), a plain-language summary of the main changes from its release notes, and a markdown link to the release page. Then save the newest tag to the file. Skip drafts. Deliver the update to the user in this chat. If there is no new release, send nothing.

Fires on:
- cron `CRON_TZ=America/Moncton 0 8-22/2 * * *`

Ask the importing user for:
- Timezone
